name: ღამის მონადირეები
overview:
The story is about a group called “Night Hunters.” They go out at night wearing masks and enforce their own kind of justice in the city. They brutally punish criminals and help the vulnerable.

You might think of many similar superhero stories, but believe me — there are no heroes here. They are hiding a very big secret, which other characters in the series slowly begin to uncover.
